name: telecom_pairs_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: India's telecom sector is effectively a duopoly: Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio (via Reliance Industries). Vodafone Idea (Vi) is a distant, stressed third player. Airtel and Jio compete for the same ~1.1 billion subscribers with near-identical pricing plans (post-tariff hikes), similar capex cycles (5G rollout), and shared regulatory framework (TRAI). The intraday correlation between Airtel and Reliance (overall) is 0.35-0.45, but when isolated to telecom-specific news events (tariff hikes, TRAI regulations, spectrum auctions, ARPU data), the correlation spikes to 0.65+. The pairs trade: when telecom-specific news drives one stock but the other lags, fade the laggard expecting catch-up. Vodafone Idea serves as a useful sentiment indicator — when Vi rallies, it signals sector-wide positive sentiment.
universe: Bharti Airtel, Reliance Industries (Jio proxy), Vodafone Idea (sentiment indicator)
stock_filter: Airtel: ADV > ₹300 crore. Reliance: ADV > ₹2000 crore. Vi: ADV > ₹50 crore

other: Jio revenue estimate based on RIL segment reporting

indicators.name: telecom_sentiment
indicators.formula: (airtel_return + ril_return * 0.3 + vi_return * 0.2) / 1.5 (Jio is ~30% of RIL value)

indicators.name: airtel_ril_spread
indicators.formula: airtel_return - ril_return * 0.3 (comparing Airtel to Jio-equivalent RIL move)

conditions: vi_return > 0 (Vi rising confirms telecom sector sentiment is positive, Airtel should follow)
telecom-specific news today (tariff, TRAI, spectrum — not RIL conglomerate news)
long.confirmation: Airtel starts turning up (close > close[1] AND close > VWAP * 0.999)

conditions: vi_return < 0 (Vi falling confirms sector pressure, Airtel should underperform)
short.confirmation: Airtel starts turning down (close < close[1] AND close < VWAP * 1.001)

entry.entry_price: market order on Airtel (more liquid telecom pure-play, no conglomerate noise)

risk.position_sizing: ₹1L on Airtel (directional, using RIL-Jio as reference)

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.event_filter: prefer telecom-specific news days. Skip on RIL result day (conglomerate noise dominates Jio signal)
other_filters: skip if RIL is moving on O2C/Retail news (not Jio-driven, RIL_return * 0.3 is meaningless)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — the Airtel-Jio duopoly is structural, but the RIL-Jio value decomposition (30% weight) is a crude approximation that may shift as Jio prepares for a potential IPO.

weaknesses: Using RIL as a Jio proxy is fundamentally flawed — RIL moves on O2C, Retail, and group-level news. The 0.3 weight is an estimate that may be inaccurate on any given day.
Vodafone Idea is a distressed stock with high speculative activity. Its return direction may reflect speculative flows, not genuine telecom sector sentiment.
Trade frequency is low — telecom-specific news days occur perhaps 2-4 times per month. The strategy is idle most of the time.
prior_art: Pairs trading literature. In India, telecom duopoly dynamics are studied by ICRA and CRISIL in their sector reports. TRAI quarterly performance indicator reports provide subscriber/ARPU data. Morgan Stanley SOTP analysis of RIL for Jio valuation.
notes: If Jio IPOs separately, this strategy becomes significantly cleaner — direct Airtel-Jio pair without the RIL conglomerate noise. Monitor SEBI filings for Jio Platforms listing plans. Also consider using NIFTY Telecom ETF if it becomes liquid enough for intraday trading.
